overview.text: This issue provides a narrow incident and public-health review, not a comprehensive national assessment. The supplied evidence cannot support a weekly incident total or comparison with the previous issue.

developments.title: Police ambushed in Zamfara
developments.event_timing_note: The report places the attack on its publication Monday, within the reporting window.

paragraphs.text: Channels Television reported an ambush on police travelling along the Sokoto–Gusau road. Sources alleged deaths and abductions, but casualty numbers remained unverified. A zonal police spokesperson confirmed the incident without providing further details.

evidence.quote: the exact number of casualties could not be ascertained

paragraphs.text: The supplied evidence is insufficient to assess security or humanitarian developments here.

WHO’s bulletin, published during the reporting week, described completed follow-up for some Nigerian contacts of the earlier imported Bundibugyo virus case in Abuja. Its Nigerian contact-monitoring snapshot was from early in the week; investigation and contact tracing continued.

evidence.quote: Six contacts have successfully completed the 21-day follow-up period.
